messages:
jon_sales: Quick handoff for Protea Health (enterprise trial). They want Private deployment (VPC + optional on-prem gateway), SAML SSO, IP allowlist, and initial benchmarking on 2x A100. Expected monthly usage ~200M tokens. Procurement timeline ~45 days; flagged renewal sensitivity if perf/cost targets aren't met. Deal doc: https://redwood.example.com/deals/PROTEA-1123

maria_cs: Thanks @jon_sales — Ill take lead on CS. Two quick clarifying Qs: 1) Do they need Dedicated reserved capacity or fully private control plane? 2) Who is the IdP contact for SAML metadata?

jon_sales: They asked for Private (customer VPC + optional on-prem gateway) and SSO. I shared AM contact (elena@proteahealth). No SAML metadata yet; procurement requested a sample SAML request we usually provide. Quoted 2xA100 to hit p95 latency target during benchmark.

maria_cs: Got it. @devon_eng can you confirm feasibility and lead time for 2x A100 capacity in their preferred region and draft a minimal network template we can share? We'll need ASN/CIDR requirements and firewall rule examples for procurement.

devon_eng: Can do. Need customer ASN + target CIDR and whether they expect outbound internet egress or private-only. Also note: cross-replica KV caching requires a pinned model + quantization profile (affects memory). Which model are they planning?

jon_sales: They're starting with redwood/fast-7b, open to testing q4 variants for cost. I'll update deal notes with model choice and procurement contact.

sam_support_bot: New ticket created: CS-4821  Protea provisioning & onboarding. https://tickets.internal/CS-4821

maria_cs: Action items (added to CS-4821):
- devon_eng: post infra checklist (ASN, CIDR, peering window, firewall rules) + sample network template and sanitized SAML metadata example.
- devon_eng: validate 2xA100 scheduling ETA and any constraints for region.
- lara_support: draft migration/playback runbook and escalation contacts; prepare hosted fallback plan for burst tests.
- maria_cs: enable Redwood Optimize monitoring for trial and prepare baseline prompt evals to catch quality regressions with q4.
- jon_sales: confirm procurement dates and share IdP contact and SLAs.

devon_eng: ETA: I'll attach a sanitized SAML metadata XML and a one-page network ACL template to CS-4821 by EOD. Preliminary allocation ETA ~10 business days after approvals; VPC peering depends on customer's change window. Recommended model pin: fast-7b-q4, include expected memory and latency numbers.

lara_support: Note on risk/retry: they're price-sensitive. Recommend we enable Optimize cost dashboards during the trial so CS can show cost-per-inference and suggestions (batching, quantization) in the next review. For testing, we can allow temporary failover to hosted endpoints, but need org sign-off for cross-tenant routing.

maria_cs: Agree. I'll enable Optimize and add an eval suite to detect prompt-level regressions vs non-quantized baseline. Also scheduling kickoff call for week of 2027-04-12; will invite dev + support + AM.

jon_sales: Please make sure single owners + SLAs are listed in the ticket so I can update the customer timeline. Also note procurement mentioned they prefer fixed window dates for peering config.

maria_cs: Owners added in CS-4821: maria_cs (CS lead, primary contact), devon_eng (infra owner), lara_support (support/escalations), jon_sales (account AM). Kickoff invite sent.

sam_support_bot: Calendar: Kickoff meeting scheduled 2027-04-15 16:00 UTC. Ticket CS-4821 updated with attachments once devon posts them.

jon_sales: :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and flag if procurement shifts their dates.
